query: I have a 55-year-old female with intracranial hemorrhage. In female ICU patients aged 50–60 with ICH, what are the 25th, 50th, 90th percentiles and maximum procedure burden in initial 72 hours? Compare hospital LOS and in-hospital mortality to general ICU.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS q25, percentile_cont(0.50) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS q50, percentile_cont(0.90) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS q90, MAX(los) AS max_los FROM icustays WHERE length_of_stay > 72;
